description:
Relaxed Motorcycling

With ALPINE HEARING PROTECTION MotoSafe motorcycle earplugs you’ll never have ringing in your ears after a long ride. Did you know that at a speed of 120 kilometers per hour on average, the volume is 98 decibels? This means that after 7 minutes without hearing protection you risk permanent damage. In addition, without motorcycle ear plugs noise reduction you become tired faster, which leads to poor concentration. For this reason, ALPINE HEARING PROTECTION have developed comfortable reusable ear plugs for racing.

Optimal Attenuation for Track Circuits

ALPINE HEARING PROTECTION MotoSafe Race noise reducing ear plugs damp the harmful noise, while traffic, navigation, intercom and the motorcycle itself remain audible. The motorcycle ear plugs have a high attenuation of 20 SNR, making the reusable earplugs ideal for use on the track or with open helmets.

Unique Material for Complete Comfort

ALPINE HEARING PROTECTION MotoSafe motorcycle earplugs are made of durable and flexible AlpineThermoShape material which molds to the ear canal to achieve a perfect fit. ALPINE HEARING PROTECTION MotoSafe reusable earplugs are also the only ones on the market with soft filters, which makes them very comfortable under a helmet. Our motorcycle ear plugs are also hypoallergenic – the no-silicone ear plugs do not sweat, itch or irritate, allowing you to ride all day in comfort, and the minigrip design makes them easy to remove when your ride is over to replace in the handy storage bag.

MotoSafe Motorcycle Ear Plugs Range

Also available are medium attenuation ALPINE HEARING PROTECTION MotoSafe Tour noise reduction ear plugs for motorcycle touring and motorway riding. Or for complete flexibility, the ALPINE HEARING PROTECTION MotoSafe Pro kit consists of one set of MotoSafe Tour and one set of MotoSafe Race ear plugs.

EP4 Sonic Defenders Plus מגנים על השמיעה שלכם מבלי להפריע ליכולת שלכם לשמוע צלילים או שיחות שגרתיות. עיצוב הגבעול המשולש שלהם מתאים לתעלות אוזניים גדולות יותר ומספק דירוג הפחתת רעש (NRR) של 24dB. צלילים, ברמות בטוחות, מותרים לעבור דרך תעלת האוזן, בעוד רעשים שעלולים להיות מזיקים (מעל 85dB) מופחתים באמצעות עיצוב קנייני המשלב מסנן מיוחד להפחתת רעשים. EP4 Sonic Defenders Plus schützt Ihr Gehör ohne Ihre Fähigkeit zu stören, Routine-Sounds oder Gespräche zu hören. EP4s enthalten angebrachte Filterkappen, die für zusätzlichen Schutz eingesetzt werden können und niedrigere Geräusche blockieren, wie das im Flugzeug gehört wird, wo Umgebungsgeräusche oder Gespräche nicht entscheidend sind. description:
If you work in the military or law enforcement, getting exposed to the noise of gunshots and artillery shots is a fact of life. Unfortunately, this “fact of life” can lead to hearing loss in the long run —and even right away, depending on where you’re stationed. The American Speech Language Hearing Association points out that exposure to 140 dB which is less that almost all firearms can result in permanent hearing damage.

Reduce Harmful Noise While Maintaining Sound Directionality

To prevent this from happening, you should wear noise attenuating hearing protectors like the Earmonix Shooting Earplugs. They are specially designed to protect the wearer from the noise made by gunshots, explosions, and artillery shots. These ear plugs are designed for outdoor shooting and if used for indoor shooting ranges double protection is always recommended.

The Earmonix Shooting Earplugs are specially designed to protect your ears while still allowing you to hear what’s going on in your environment. Retaining sound spatiality and directionality are critical in military and law enforcement work to maintain alertness. When there is no high-impulse noise present they provide a NRR rated 12dB of continuous protection allowing you to hear background noise as well as the voices of the people around you. However with loud sound bursts such as firearms or explosions their specially designed reactive filters can provide up to 33dB of attenuation reducing dangerous sounds to a safe level. 

Convenient and Useful in Many Work Places

These ear plugs also work great for protection from many high impulse noises such as pneumatic power tools used in automotive and machining or even nail guns used in construction. However their reactive filters are not designed for work places with constant loud noise levels. They also come with a handy carry case with keyring or the slim design is perfect to just slip in your pocket.

description:
More than 40 years ago this simple hearing protector, the world’s first foam ear plug, revolutionized hearing protection in the workplace and has remained to this day one of the most widely used earplugs in the world. The 3M E-A-R Classic Ear Plugs are constructed from slow-recovery, low-pressure foam. They fit snugly to create a noise barrier that helps protect hearing from loud sounds. These ear plugs are stiff enough when compressed to make fitting easier, yet soft enough to be comfortable in the ear for extended wear. Bright yellow color allows supervisors to conduct quick visual, hearing protection compliance checks. Recommended applications include chipping, chiseling, drilling, furnace operations, grinding, heavy equipment operations, machining, pouring/casting, power fastening, riveting, sanding, sawing and welding. These ear plugs are commonly used in the following industries: agriculture, automotive, chemicals, construction, general manufacturing, healthcare, oil and gas, and pharmaceuticals. These earplugs have a Noise Reduction Rating (NRR) of 29 dB, CSA Class AL. Can be fit tested with the 3M E-A-Rfit Validation System. Moisture resistance helps maintain a consistent fit, even when humidity is present. Noise is not only present in our daily routines, but millions of Americans work in hazardous noise on a daily basis. Estimates from the National Institutes of Health suggest that approximately 15 percent of Americans (26 million people) between the ages of 20 and 69 have high frequency hearing loss due to exposure to noise at work or during leisure activities. Hearing loss due to noise is almost entirely preventable by consistent use of hearing protection. Note: 3M strongly recommends fit testing of hearing protectors. Research suggests that many users will receive less noise reduction than indicated by the NRR due to variation in hearing protector fit, fitting skill, and motivation of the user. If the NRR is used, 3M recommends that it be reduced by 50% or in accordance with applicable regulations. description: Pacato 19 Pacato from ACS brings a whole new level of fidelity and comfort to ready-to-go earplugs. Now with new packaging and contents, designed to reduce waste and single use plastic. Available in varying sizes, the Pacato plug is comfortable, completely discreet and offers the most natural sound of any generic fit earplug in its class. With Pacato you can hear what you need to hear with all the clarity that you're used to and easily converse and communicate without putting your hearing at risk. The Pacato is one of the most discreet universal-fit plugs available with a flush fitting filter that enables the plug to sit comfortably in the ear with no protrusion making them ideal for use under headwear or in any situation where discretion for the wearer is desired. Offering an average of 19dB protection the Pacato is suitable for use in most amplified music or other loud noise environments keeping your hearing safe from damaging exposure to excessive noise but ensuring that you stay involved in the performance. Using Pacato earplugs you can enjoy your music at a level that suits you without losing the fidelity of the sound as you might with foam earplugs, in addition, the Pacato keeps all the atmosphere allowing you to hear what's going on around you and communicate clearly with others so you don't have to feel isolated from the music, the atmosphere or the people to keep your hearing safe from harm. Trying to create a natural sounding earplug is no mean feat as far as your own voice is concerned because, as you will have experienced, when you block off your ear canal your own voice starts to boom inside your head, this is what we call occlusion. Occlusion is caused by sound that is carried to your ear canal through the cartilage at the side of your head and usually escapes through the open ear canal so is not heard. When we block off the canal this sound cannot escape and so creates that booming effect.

description:
More than 40 years ago this simple hearing protector, the world’s first foam ear plug, revolutionized hearing protection in the workplace and has remained to this day one of the most widely used ear plugs in the world. The 3M E-A-R Classic Superfit Ear Plugs come with an orange “fitting ring” that provides a guideline to show when the earplugs are properly inserted for optimal hearing protection. Slow recovery, low pressure foam fits snugly to create a noise barrier that helps protect hearing from high level sounds. These ear plugs are stiff enough when compressed to make fitting easy, yet soft enough to be comfortable in the ear for extended wear. Bright yellow color with the orange fitting ring allows supervisors to conduct a quick visual hearing protection compliance check. Recommended applications include chipping, chiseling, drilling, furnace operations, grinding, heavy equipment operations, machining, pouring/casting, power fastening, riveting, sanding, sawing and welding. These earplugs are commonly used in the following industries: agriculture, automotive, chemicals, construction, general manufacturing, healthcare, oil and gas, and pharmaceuticals. These ear plugs have a Noise Reduction Rating (NRR) of 29 dB, CSA Class AL. * Can be fit tested with the 3M E-A-Rfit Validation System. Moisture resistance helps maintain a consistent fit, even when humidity is present. Not only is noise present in our daily routines, but millions of Americans work in hazardous noise on a daily basis. Estimates from the National Institutes of Health suggest that approximately 15 percent of Americans (26 million people) between the ages of 20 and 69 have high frequency hearing loss due to exposure to noise at work or during leisure activities. Hearing loss due to noise is almost entirely preventable by consistent use of hearing protection. * Note: 3M strongly recommends fit testing of hearing protectors. Research suggests that many users will receive less noise reduction than indicated by the NRR due to variation in hearing protector fit, fitting skill, and motivation of the user. EPA INFORMATION:

The level of noise entering a person’s ear, when a hearing protector is worn as directed, is closely approximated by the difference between the A-weighted environmental noise level and the NRR.

Example:

1. The environmental noise level as measured at the ear is 92 dB(A).
2. The NRR is 33 decibels (dB).
3. The level of noise entering the ear is approximately equal to [92 dB(A) -33] 59 dB (A).
CAUTION: For noise environments dominated by frequencies below 500 Hz, the C-weighted environmental noise level should be used. Improper fit of this device will reduce its effectiveness in attenuating noise. Consult the enclosed instructions for proper fit. Although hearing protectors can be recommended for protection against the harmful effects of impulsive noise, the Noise Reduction Rating (NRR) is based on the attenuation of continuous noise and may not be an accurate indicator of the protection attainable against impulsive noise such as gunfire.

description:
Alpine FlyFit Airplane Ear Plugs

Every year, millions of people fly across the world, and a large number of people experience an unpleasant pressure or pain in their ears during take-off or landing. Others find the noise in the plane disruptive and tiresome. To this end, Alpine has developed special airplane earplugs: pressure reducing FlyFit. These reusable earplugs are equipped with a unique filter system, so travelers use FlyFit earplugs for sleep on overnight flights, and improved comfort when they are awake.

AlpineAcousticFilters - Pressure-regulating airplane earplugs

FlyFit travel earplugs regulate the uncomfortable pressure on the eardrums during take off or landing. The filters in the noise reducing ear plugs act as a valve and realize a gradual and constant pressure balance between the outside world and the mid-ear. This gives the Eustachian tube sufficient time to adapt to the differences in pressure. In addition, the special AlpineAcousticFilters in the Alpine FlyFit noise reducing earplugs absorb annoying ambient noise. Providing rest and relaxation, travelers can use the earplugs for sleep during long flights or for car, train and bus trips.

AlpineThermoShape Material

The innovative FlyFit airplane pressure earplugs are made of special thermoplastic material, developed by Alpine: AlpineThermoShape. This material takes on the shape of the ear, so the small earplugs have a perfect fit and stay in position at all times, which guarantees optimal absorption and comfort without unpleasant pressure on the ears. The zero silicone earplugs are also hypoallergenic.

FlyFit Airplane Ear Plugs Packaging Contents

- Two universal thermoplastic hearing protectors
- Two acoustic soft filters
- Alpine cleaner
- Plastic carrying case
- Alpine insertion sleeve


Alpine FlyFit Airplane Tapones para los oídos

Cada año, millones de personas vuelan por todo el mundo, y un gran número de personas experimentan una presión o dolor desagradable en sus oídos durante el despegue o aterrizaje. Otros encuentran el ruido en el plano disruptivo y cansado. Con este fin, Alpine ha desarrollado tapones especiales para los oídos de los aviones: FlyFit. Estos tapones reutilizables para los oídos están equipados con un sistema de filtro único, por lo que los viajeros usan tapones para los oídos FlyFit para dormir en vuelos nocturnos y una mayor comodidad cuando están despiertos.

AlpineAcousticFilters - Tapones para los oídos de los aviones que regulan la presión

Los tapones para los oídos FlyFit regulan la presión incómoda sobre los tímpanos durante el despegue o aterrizaje. Los filtros en los tapones para los oídos reducen el ruido actúan como una válvula y realizan un equilibrio de presión gradual y constante entre el mundo exterior y el oído medio. Esto le da al tubo de Eustaquio tiempo suficiente para adaptarse a las diferencias de presión. Además, los especiales AlpineAcousticFilters en el Alpine FlyFit reducción de ruido tapones para los oídos absorben molestos ruidos ambientales. Proporcionando descanso y relajación, los viajeros pueden usar los tapones para los oídos para dormir durante vuelos largos o para viajes en coche, tren y autobús.

Material AlpineThermoShape

Los innovadores tapones para los oídos FlyFit están hechos de material termoplástico especial, desarrollado por Alpine: AlpineThermoShape. Este material adquiere la forma de la oreja, por lo que los pequeños tapones para los oídos tienen un ajuste perfecto y permanecen en posición en todo momento, lo que garantiza una absorción óptima y comodidad sin una presión desagradable en los oídos. Los tapones de silicona cero también son hipoalergénicos.

title: Sanohra Fly (Regular) - Pressure and Noise Sound reducing Ear Plugs for Flying - Against Airplanes Ear
bullet_point: [Have a safe flight, use SANOHRA fly earplugs, Relieves inflight ear discomfort, Relieves air pressure discomfort with exclusive filter, Filter regulates air pressure and noises, More flights with 6 flight segments]
description:
SANOHRA fly ear plugs

More than half of all air passengers know the uncomfortable pressure feeling or pain in the ear that can occur during air travel, especially while landing. The ear is a very sensitive organ. The middle ear, which is located behind the eardrum, is airtight. When the air pressure in the aircraft cabin rapidly increases while landing, a relative low pressure is created in the middle ear.

SANOHRA fly ear plugs, have been specifically designed to protect the ear against rapid and excessive changes in air pressure. A pressure regulator, which has been integrated into the earplug, regulates and slows down the pressure changes in front of the eardrum.

 

SANOHRA fly ear plugs protects the ear

SANOHRA fly ear plugs are put in 45 minutes before landing. The cabin pressure that rapidly increases in a few minutes is slowed down and increases gradually in front of the eardrum. Thus, the Eustachian tube gets more time to aerate the middle ear, even with restricted functionality, before ear pain sets in.

 

Tested at the Charité hospital in Berlin/Germany

In the first systematic and prospective study at the ENT Clinic at the Charité Mitte campus, a select group of test subjects who were known to have ear problems while flying, were studied in a pressure chamber. In the process, a significant reduction in the pain sensation could be demonstrated using the filter by delaying the change in pressure.

 

SANOHRA fly ear plugs made in Germany

description:
Doc's ProPlugs can prevent swimmers ear, and ear pain by blocking water from entering the ears, keeping ears warm and preventing the flushing of water in and out of the ear. Ear pain and infection are caused by cold exposure and erosion of delicate skin and wax in the ear canal. Upon descent, ProPlugs prevent water from entering the ear down to 20 feet in depth. Once the diver enters greater depths, water will be allowed into the ear for equalization. Unlike other earplugs, ours includes a Scotts valve which allows ears to equalize easily and let sound in. Our ProPlugs have been used by hundreds of divers for over thirty years who testify that ProPlugs are the earplugs for divers. Equalization with Doc's ProPlugs: Doc's ProPlugs have also been used by divers who have trouble equalizing. Unlike other earplugs which are solid and would not be recommended for diving, ProPlugs are vented to allow equalization. While the small vent allows equalization to occur it does not allow debris to enter and it prevents earwax from washing out which exposes delicate ear tissue. The ProPlugs keep ears warm by storing the head's conductive heat; the warmth provided by the plugs drastically reduces the risk of thermal shock. Due to surface tension the vented plug also reduces abrupt pressure changes from reaching the sensitive eardrum which contributes to easier equalization. Clear ears often to allow air to escape through the ProPlugs vent and allow for better equalization. ProPlug wearers who have trouble clearing their ears should check to make sure a lump of ear wax is not blocking the canal or butting up against the vent. If the vent is fouled by debris while descending it is best to remove the ProPlug. If fouled while ascending, there is no problem because the air and water under pressure can escape around the ProPlug.Hundreds of divers have attested to the benefits of ProPlugs for relieving pressure in their ear during descent.

El dolor de oído y la infección son causados por la exposición al frío y la erosión de la piel delicada y la cera en el canal auditivo. Al descender, ProPlugs evita que el agua entre en la oreja hasta 20 pies de profundidad. Una vez que el buzo entre más profundidades, el agua se permitirá en el oído para la ecualización. A diferencia de otros tapones para los oídos, la nuestra incluye una válvula Scotts que permite que las orejas se igualen fácilmente y dejen entrar el sonido. Nuestros ProPlugs han sido utilizados por cientos de buceadores durante más de treinta años que testifican que ProPlugs son los tapones para los oídos para buceadores. Ecualización con ProPlugs: Doc's ProPlugs también han sido utilizados por buzos que tienen problemas para igualar. A diferencia de otros tapones para los oídos que son sólidos y no se recomiendan para bucear, ProPlugs están ventilados para permitir la ecualización. Mientras que el pequeño respiradero permite que ocurra la ecualización, no permite la entrada de desechos y evita que la cera de los oídos se lave, lo que expone el tejido delicado del oído. Los ProPlugs mantienen las orejas calientes al almacenar el calor conductor de la cabeza; el calor proporcionado por los tapones reduce drásticamente el riesgo de choque térmico. Debido a la tensión superficial, el tapón ventilado también reduce los cambios bruscos de presión al llegar al tímpano sensible, lo que contribuye a una ecualización más fácil. Doc's ProPlugs können Ohren- und Ohrenschmerzen durch das Eindringen von Wasser in die Ohren verhindern, die Ohren warm halten und das Eindringen von Wasser in und aus dem Ohr verhindern. Ohrenschmerzen und Infektionen werden durch Kälte und Erosion von empfindlicher Haut und Wachs im Gehörgang verursacht. Beim Abstieg verhindern ProPlugs das Eindringen von Wasser in das Ohr bis zu 6 m Tiefe. Sobald der Taucher in größere Tiefen eintritt, wird Wasser zum Ausgleich ins Ohr gelassen. Im Gegensatz zu anderen Ohrstöpseln verfügt unsere über ein Scotts Ventil, mit dem die Ohren leicht ausgeglichen werden können und Geräusche hereinlassen können. Unsere ProPlugs werden seit über dreißig Jahren von Hunderten von Tauchern verwendet, die beweisen, dass ProPlugs die Ohrstöpsel für Taucher sind. Ausgleich mit Doc's ProPlugs: Doc's ProPlugs wurden auch von Tauchern verwendet, die Schwierigkeiten beim Ausgleichen haben. Im Gegensatz zu anderen Ohrstöpseln, die solide sind und nicht zum Tauchen empfohlen werden, sind ProPlugs belüftet, um einen Ausgleich zu ermöglichen. Während die kleine Entlüftung einen Ausgleich ermöglicht, lässt es keinen Schmutz eindringen und es verhindert, dass Ohrenschmalz ausgewaschen wird, wodurch empfindliches Ohrgewebe freigelegt wird. Die ProPlugs halten die Ohren warm, indem sie die leitfähige Wärme des Kopfes speichern; die Wärme der Stecker reduziert das Risiko eines thermischen Schocks drastisch. Durch die Oberflächenspannung reduziert der belüftete Stecker auch abrupte Druckveränderungen beim Erreichen des empfindlichen Trommelfells, was zu einem leichteren Ausgleich beiträgt. Klare Ohren oft, damit Luft durch den ProPlugs entweichen kann und einen besseren Ausgleich ermöglichen. ProPlug-Träger, die Schwierigkeiten haben, ihre Ohren zu reinigen, sollten überprüfen, ob ein Klumpen Ohrenschmalz den Kanal nicht blockiert oder gegen die Lüftung stößt. Wenn die Lüftung beim Abstieg durch Schmutz verschmutzt ist, ist es am besten, den ProPlug zu entfernen. Wenn sie beim Aufstieg verschmutzt sind, gibt es kein Problem, da Luft und Wasser unter Druck um den ProPlug entweichen können. Hunderte von Tauchern haben die Vorteile von ProPlugs zur Druckentlastung im Ohr während des Abfahrts bestätigt.

يمكن لبروبلاجز أن تمنع سباحين الأذن والأذن عن طريق منع دخول الماء إلى الأذن والحفاظ على دفء الأذنين ومنع تسرب الماء داخل الأذن وخارجها. ألم الأذن والعدوى الناجمة عن التعرض للبرد وتآكل الجلد الحساس والشمع في قناة الأذن. عند النزل، تمنع بروبلاجز الماء من الدخول إلى الأذن حتى عمق 20 قدم. بمجرد دخول الغواص إلى عمق أكبر، سيتم السماح بالمياه في الأذن للمعادلة. على عكس سدادات الأذن الأخرى، يتضمن صمام سكوتش الذي يسمح للأذنين بتحقيق التوازن بسهولة والسماح بدخول الصوت. تم استخدام سدادات بروبلاجز الخاصة بنا من قبل مئات الغواصين لأكثر من ثلاثين عامًا يشهد أن سدادات الأذن هي سدادات الأذن للغواصين المحاذاة مع بروبلاجز الطبيب: تم استخدام بروبلاجز الطبيب أيضًا من قبل الغواصين الذين يعانون من مشكلة في المعادلة. على عكس سدادات الأذن الأخرى التي تكون صلبة ولا يوصى بها للغوص، فإن سدادات بروبلاجز تسمح بالتوازن. في حين أن الفتحة الصغيرة تسمح بتحقيق المعادلة، إلا أنها لا تسمح بدخول البقايا وتمنع غسل شمع الأذن مما يكشف عن أنسجة الأذن الحساسة. تحافظ سدادات بروبلاجز على دفء الأذنين عن طريق تخزين الحرارة الموصلة للرأس، كما يقلل الدفء الذي توفره المقابس بشكل كبير من خطر الصدمات الحرارية. بسبب الشد السطحي، يقلل القابس المزود بفتحات تهوية من تغييرات الضغط المفاجئة من الوصول إلى طبلة الأذن الحساسة التي تساهم في سهولة الموازنة. تقوم الأذن بتنظيف الأذن في كثير من الأحيان للسماح للهواء بالهروب من خلال فتحة بروبلاجز والسماح بمعادلة أفضل. يجب على مرتدي بروبلاج الذين يعانون من مشكلة في تنظيف أذنيهم التحقق للتأكد من أن كتلة شمع الأذن لا تحجب القناة أو تنبعها أمام الفتحة. إذا تم تنفيس الهواء بالبقايا أثناء الهبوط فمن الأفضل إزالة قابس البروبلاغ. إذا تم الخلط أثناء الارتفع، لا توجد مشكلة لأن الهواء والماء تحت الضغط يمكن أن يهرب حول بروبلاج. وقد أثبت مئات الغواصين فوائد بروبلاجز لتخفيف الضغط على أذنهم أثناء النزل.

يعاني الكثير منا من الضغط والألم المتراكم في أذننا عندما تنطلق رحلاتنا وهبوطها، أو حتى عندما نقود عبر الجبال والوسائد. بالنسبة لأولئك الذين يحبون السفر، ولكنهم لا يرغبون في الألم المرتبط بالطيران والقيادة، فقد يصبح الأمر كافيًا من مشكلة في الخروج من رحلة. لا يوجد لدى الأشخاص الذين يسافرون للعمل سوى الاستمتاع بالألم.

من السهل إدخالها وتظل مريحة في مكانها مع توفير مقاس مخصص. بفضل هيكله المتين والمرن، يمكن أن تساعد في تخفيف الصداع والصداع والغثيان وتفرغ الأذن والخشونة وزيادة الضغط المرتبط بتغيرات الارتفاع - حتى أثناء الاضطراب.

لا تسبب الحساسية، وقابلة للغسل اليدوي، وقابلة لإعادة الاستخدام لما يصل إلى خمس رحلات. بصفتها بديلاً خالٍ من الأدوية، فإنها لا تحتوي على أي آثار جانبية قد تتعرض لها في كثير من الأحيان مع مزيلات الاحتقان والأدوية المشابهة. ومع ذلك، لا ينبغي أن يستخدمها الأطفال أقل من 12 سنة.

تتضمن حقيبة تخزين مريحة حتى لا تفقدها في الجزء السفلي من حقيبتك، مما يجعلها سهلة الاسترداد لرحلتك القادمة أو رحلة برية.

يمكن أن تكون هذه أداة تغيير الألعاب لأولئك الذين يرغبون في قضاء عطلة أو الذهاب في رحلة عمل. قلل من الانزعاج الناجم عن الطيران والقيادة مع سدادات الأذن هذه التي تقلل الضغط حتى تتمكن من الوصول إلى وجهتك دون ألم.



Muitos de nós experimentamos pressão e dor acumulados em nossos ouvidos quando nossos voos decolam e aterram, ou mesmo quando estamos dirigindo por montanhas e vales. Para aqueles que amam viajar, mas não querem a dor associada ao voo e à condução, pode se tornar um problema suficiente parar de uma viagem. Aqueles que viajam para o trabalho não têm escolha a não ser suportar a dor.

No entanto, estes tampões de ouvido redutores de pressão podem ajudar a aliviar a pressão que você experimenta com mudanças de altitude. Testado de acordo com a norma EN 352-2: 1993, eles reduzem o ruído de fundo até 22dB, mas não filtram o discurso, para que você possa ouvir música, falar com outras pessoas, assistir a filmes e ouvir anúncios da equipe de voo.

Elas são fáceis de inserir e permanecem confortavelmente no lugar, proporcionando um ajuste personalizado. Elas são hipoalergênicas, laváveis à mão e reutilizáveis para até cinco voos. Um estojo de armazenamento conveniente está incluído para que você não os perca na parte inferior da sua bolsa, o que também os torna facilmente recuperáveis para o seu próximo voo ou viagem rodoviária.

Pode ser uma mudança de jogo para aqueles que querem tirar férias ou ter que ir em uma viagem de negócios. Reduza o desconforto causado por voar e dirigir com estes tampões de ouvido que reduzem a pressão para que você possa chegar ao seu destino sem dor.

우리 중 많은 사람들은 비행이 이륙하고 착륙할 때, 또는 산과 계곡을 지나갈 때에도 귀에 압력과 통증을 겪습니다. 여행을 좋아하지만 비행과 운전과 관련된 통증을 원하지 않는 분들을 위해, 여행을 떠날 때 문제가 될 수 있습니다. 직장을 위해 여행하는 사람들은 고통을 견딜 수 밖에 없습니다.

그러나 이러한 압력 감소 귀마개는 고도 변화에 대해 겪는 압력을 완화하는 데 도움이 됩니다. EN 352-2: 1993에 따라 테스트되었습니다. 배경 소음을 최대 22dB까지 줄이지만 음성을 필터링하지 않으므로 여전히 음악을 듣고, 다른 사람들과 이야기하고, 영화를 보고, 비행 직원으로부터 알림을 들을 수 있습니다.

삽입하기 쉽고 제자리에 편안하게 유지하면서 맞춤형 핏을 제공합니다. 내구성이 뛰어나지만 유연한 구조로 난기류 중에도 고도와 관련된 두통, 현기증, 메스꺼움, 귀가 튀어 나오거나 답답답함 및 고도의 변화와 관련된 압박을 완화하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

저자극성이며 손세탁이 가능하며 최대 5개의 비행에서 재사용이 가능합니다. 약물이 없는 대안으로, 충혈 완화제 및 비슷한 약물에서 자주 겪는 부작용이 없습니다. 그러나 12세 미만의 어린이는 사용할 수 없습니다.

편리한 보관 케이스가 포함되어 있어 가방 바닥에 가방을 잃어버리지 않으며, 다음 비행이나 도로 여행을 위해 쉽게 꺼낼 수 있습니다.

휴가를 즐기거나 출장을 가야하는 사람들을 위한 게임 체인저가 될 수 있습니다. 이 압력 감소 귀마개로 비행과 운전으로 인한 불편함을 줄여 목적지에 고통 없이 도착할 수 있습니다.

description:
Alpine SwimSafe Earplugs for Swimming

Many people suffer discomfort in their ears when swimming. In addition, water sports enthusiasts often want to protect their ears against water and wind when surfing, sailing or wakeboarding to prevent an ear infection or swimmer’s ear. Especially for that purpose, Alpine has developed SwimSafe swimming earplugs. These special earplugs for swimming, water sports and showering prevent water from penetrating the ear. Thanks to the unique filters, ambient sounds can still be heard while the swim earplugs are in place.

Alpine Acoustic Filters - Say No to Water & Yes to Sound

The special acoustic filters in the SwimSafe earplugs for swimming allow you to keep hearing all ambient sounds and conversations. The extremely small opening in the swim ear plugs filters prevent the wearer from feeling disconnected and the shape of the reusable earplugs prevents any water from penetrating the ear. SwimSafe swimming earplugs for adults are suitable for a maximum distance of one meter under water.

Comfortable AlpineThermoShape Material

The innovative Alpine swimming ear plugs are made of AlpineThermoShape, a thermoplastic material developed by Alpine. This material takes on the shape of the ear, so the adult swimming earplugs have a perfect fit and stay where they are at all times. That guarantees optimal absorption and comfort without unpleasant pressure on the ears. ATS is hypoallergenic, and SwimSafe are zero silicone earplugs.

Alpine Miniboxx

In addition to the convenient carrying case, you will also find a cool Alpine Miniboxx in the SwimSafe swimming ear plugs packaging. This convenient carrying case makes it easy to take your swim earplugs with you to the pool, and when you're swimming it can be easily attached to your wrist.

✔ Two acoustic filters

Alpine SwimSafe 수영용 이어플러그

많은 사람들이 수영할 때 귀에 불편함을 겪습니다. 또한, 수상 스포츠 애호가들은 서핑, 항해 또는 웨이크보딩을 할 때 귀 감염이나 수영하는 사람의 귀를 물과 바람으로부터 보호하고자 합니다. 특히 이러한 목적을 위해 Alpine은 SwimSafe 수영 이어플러그를 개발했습니다. 수영, 수상 스포츠 및 샤워를 위한 이 특별한 이어플러그는 물이 귀에 침투하는 것을 방지합니다. 독특한 필터 덕분에 수영 이어플러그가 제자리에 있는 동안 주변 소리를 들을 수 있습니다.

알파인 어쿠스틱 필터 - 물 거절과 소리 방지.

수영용 SwimSafe 이어플러그의 특수 음향 필터를 사용하면 모든 주변 사운드와 대화를 계속 들을 수 있습니다. 수영 이어 플러그 필터의 매우 작은 구멍은 착용자가 연결이 끊어지는 것을 방지하고 재사용 가능한 이어플러그의 모양은 물이 귀에 침투하는 것을 방지합니다. 성인용 SwimSafe 수영 이어플러그는 물 아래에서 최대 1미터(1미터)의 거리에 적합합니다.

편안한 AlpineThermoShape 소재.

혁신적인 알파인 수영 이어 플러그는 Alpine이 개발한 열가소성 소재인 AlpineThermoShape로 제작되었습니다. 이 소재는 귀 모양을 잡아주므로 성인용 수영 귀마개는 항상 완벽한 착용감을 제공하며 항상 제자리에 고정됩니다. 귀에 불쾌한 압박이 없이 최적의 흡수와 편안함을 보장합니다. ATS는 저자극성이며, SwimSafe는 실리콘 이어플러그가 없습니다.

알파인 미니박스.

편리한 휴대용 케이스 외에도 SwimSafe 수영 이어 플러그 포장에 멋진 Alpine Miniboxx를 찾을 수 있습니다. 이 편리한 휴대용 케이스로 수영 이어플러그를 수영장에 쉽게 가져갈 수 있으며 수영할 때 손목에 쉽게 부착할 수 있습니다.

title: SureFire EP4 Sonic Defenders Plus filtered Earplugs, triple flanged design, reusable, Black, Large
bullet_point: [24dB Noise Reduction Rating (NRR) with filter caps inserted, Hear safe sound levels (with filter caps out) as if you weren't wearing ear plugs, Soft, adjustable, triple-flanged stems provide secure seals in ear canals and all-day comfort, Low-profile design allows you to keep them in place while wearing a mask, helmet, hat, or while using supplemental hearing muffs, Patented EarLock retention rings utilize seven contact points to lock earpieces in place and fit the same way every time, Made in USA from hypoallergenic, medical-grade polymer that's soft, durable, and long-lasting]
description:
EP4 Sonic Defenders Plus protect your hearing without interfering with your ability to hear routine sounds or conversations. Their triple-flanged stem design fits larger ear canals and provides a Noise Reduction Rating (NRR) of 24dB. Sounds, at safe levels, are allowed to pass through into the ear canal, while potentially harmful noises (above 85dB) are reduced via a proprietary design that incorporates a special noise-reducing filter. EP4s include attached filter caps, which can be inserted for additional protection and blocking out lower-level noise, like that heard on a plane, where hearing ambient sounds or conversations isn't critical. Right/left color-coded Sonic Defenders Plus are made from a soft but durable, hypoallergenic polymer that provides all-day comfort and an extended product life (up to 6+ months, depending on usage and care). Their patented EarLock retention rings lock the earplugs in place, while soft, adjustable triple-flanged stems provide secure seals in the ear canals. A low-profile design means EP4s can be worn while wearing a helmet or mask, or while using a phone or headset. Available in clear, black, or orange. Comfortable EP4 Sonic Defenders Plus also serve as earpieces for compatible radio communication systems simply by removing the noise-reducing filter and attaching the earpiece to the system. NOTE: EP4 earpiece no longer provides hearing protection once the noise-reducing filter has been removed.

EP4 Sonic Defenders Plus מגנים על השמיעה שלכם מבלי להפריע ליכולת שלכם לשמוע צלילים או שיחות שגרתיות. עיצוב הגבעול המשולש שלהם מתאים לתעלות אוזניים גדולות יותר ומספק דירוג הפחתת רעש (NRR) של 24dB. צלילים, ברמות בטוחות, מותרים לעבור דרך תעלת האוזן, בעוד רעשים שעלולים להיות מזיקים (מעל 85dB) מופחתים באמצעות עיצוב קנייני המשלב מסנן מיוחד להפחתת רעשים. EP4s כוללים מכסי פילטר מחוברים, אשר ניתנים להכנסה להגנה נוספת וחסימת רעש ברמה נמוכה יותר, כמו שנשמע במטוס, שבו שמיעת צלילי סביבה או שיחות אינה קריטית. Sonic Defenders Plus מקודד בצבע ימין / שמאל עשויים מפולימר היפואלרגני רך אך עמיד, המספק נוחות לאורך כל היום וחיי מוצר ארוכים (עד 6 חודשים ומעלה, בהתאם לשימוש ולטיפול). טבעות השימור EarLock הרשומות כפטנט שלהן נועלות את אטמי האוזניים במקום, בעוד גבעולים רכים ומתכווננים בעלי שלוש אגזומים מאובטחים בתעלות האוזן. עיצוב פרופיל נמוך פירושו שניתן ללבוש EP4s בזמן לבישת קסדה או מסכה, או תוך שימוש בטלפון או באוזניות. זמין בצבע שקוף, שחור או כתום. מגיני EP4 Sonic Defender Plus נוחים משמשים גם כאוזניות למערכות תקשורת רדיו תואמות פשוט על ידי הסרת המסנן המפחית רעש והצמדת האוזניה למערכת. הערה: אוזניות EP4 כבר לא מספקות הגנה על השמיעה לאחר הסרת המסנן המפחית רעשים.

EP4 Sonic Defenders Plus schützt Ihr Gehör ohne Ihre Fähigkeit zu stören, Routine-Sounds oder Gespräche zu hören. Das dreifach geflanschte Design passt auf größere Gehörgänge und bietet eine Geräuschreduzierung von 24 dB. Geräusche, auf sicheren Ebenen, werden in den Gehörgang gelassen, während potenziell schädliche Geräusche (über 85 dB) durch ein proprietäres Design reduziert werden, das einen speziellen geräuschreduzierenden Filter enthält. EP4s enthalten angebrachte Filterkappen, die für zusätzlichen Schutz eingesetzt werden können und niedrigere Geräusche blockieren, wie das im Flugzeug gehört wird, wo Umgebungsgeräusche oder Gespräche nicht entscheidend sind. Rechts/links farbcodierte Sonic Defenders Plus sind aus einem weichen, aber langlebigen, hypoallergenen Polymer, das ganztägigen Komfort und eine verlängerte Produktlebensdauer (bis zu 6+ Monate, je nach Nutzung und Pflege). Die patentierten EarLock-Ringe halten die Ohrstöpsel an Ort und Stelle, während weiche, verstellbare Dreifach-Flansch-Stiele für sichere Abdichtungen in den Gehörgängen sorgen. Ein flaches Design bedeutet, dass EP4s beim Tragen eines Helms oder einer Maske oder während der Verwendung eines Telefons oder Headsets getragen werden können. Erhältlich in Transparent, Schwarz oder Orange. Komfortable EP4 Sonic Defenders Plus dienen auch als Ohrhörer für kompatible Funkkommunikationssysteme, indem Sie einfach den geräuschreduzierenden Filter entfernen und den Ohrhörer am System befestigen. Hinweis: EP4-Ohrhörer bieten keinen Gehörschutz mehr, wenn der geräuschreduzierende Filter entfernt wurde.

يحمي جهاز الحماية سونيك اي بي 4 بلس سماعك دون التداخل مع قدرتك على سماع الأصوات أو المحادثات الروتينية. تصميم الجذع ثلاثي الحواف يناسب قنوات الأذن الأكبر ويوفر معدل خفض الضوضاء (NRR) يبلغ 24 ديسيبل. يسمح بمرور الأصوات، بمستويات آمنة، إلى قناة الأذن، بينما يتم تقليل الضوضاء المحتملة (أعلى من 85 ديسيبل) من خلال تصميم خاص يتضمن فلتر خاص لتقليل الضوضاء. تتضمن EP4s أغطية فلتر مرفقة، والتي يمكن إدراجها لحماية إضافية ومنع الضوضاء المنخفضة، مثل تلك التي سمعت على الطائرة، حيث لا يكون من الضروري سماع الأصوات أو المحادثات المحيطة. تم صنع جهاز سونيك ديفيندرز بلس المرمز بالألوان اليمينة/اليسرى من البوليمر الناعم والمتين والمضاد للحساسية والذي يوفر الراحة طوال اليوم وعمر افتراضي طويل للمنتج (حتى 6 أشهر فما فوق، حسب الاستخدام والعناية). تعمل حلقات تثبيت الأذن الحاصلة على براءة اختراع على تثبيت سدادات الأذن في مكانها، بينما توفر السيقان الناعمة القابلة للتعديل ذات الحافة الثلاثية سدادات آمنة في قنوات الأذن. تصميم بسيط يعني أنه يمكن ارتداء EP4s أثناء ارتداء خوذة أو قناع أو أثناء استخدام الهاتف أو سماعة الرأس. متوفر باللون الشفاف أو الأسود أو البرتقالي. كما تعمل سماعات الرأس الصوتية EP4 Sonic Defenders Plus المريحة أيضًا كسماعات أذن لأنظمة الاتصال اللاسلكي المتوافقة ببساطة عن طريق إزالة فلتر تقليل الضوضاء وتوصيل سماعة الأذن بالنظام. ملاحظة: لم تعد سماعة الأذن EP4 توفر حماية للسمع بمجرد إزالة فلتر تقليل الضوضاء.

EP4 Sonic Defenders Plus 保護您的聽力,不會妨礙您聆聽日常聲音或對話的能力。 三法蘭桿設計適合較大的耳道,並提供24分貝的降噪等級 (NRR)。 安全級別的聲音可以通過耳道,而潛在的有害噪音 (高於 85 分貝)可通過專利設計,採用特殊的降噪過濾器來降低。 EP4s 包括附帶的濾波器蓋,可以插入以提供額外的保護和阻擋低級噪聲,就像在飛機上聽到的聲音,在那裡聽到的環境聲音或對話不是重要的。 左右顏色編碼的 Sonic Defenders Plus 採用柔軟耐用的低過敏性聚合物製成,提供全天的舒適感和延長產品壽命(長達 6 個月以上,取決於使用和保養)。 其獲得專利的 EarLock 固定環將耳塞固定到位,而柔軟、可調節的三法蘭桿可在耳道中提供安全的密封。 低調設計意味著 EP4 可以戴著頭盔或面具,或使用手機或耳機時佩戴。 有透明、黑色或橘色可供選擇。 舒適的 EP4 Sonic Defenders Plus 還可用作兼容無線電通訊系統的耳機,只需移除降噪過濾器並將耳機連接到系統上。 注意:一旦降噪濾鏡移除,EP4 耳機就不再提供聽力保護。

EP4 Sonic Defenders Plus 可在不影响您听到日常声音或对话的能力的情况下保护您的听觉。 它们的三重法兰杆设计适合较大的耳道,并提供降噪等级 (NRR) 为 24dB。 安全级别的声音允许通过耳道,同时通过带有特殊降噪滤波器的专有设计减少潜在有害噪音(85 分贝以上)。 EP4s 包括附加的过滤盖,可以插入以提供额外的保护,并阻挡较低水平的噪音,就像在飞机上听到的声音,在那里听到的环境声音或对话并不重要。 右/左颜色编码的 Sonic Defenders Plus 由柔软但耐用的低过敏性聚合物制成,提供全天的舒适性和延长产品寿命(长达 6 个月,取决于使用情况和护理情况)。 获得专利的 EarLock 固定环将耳塞锁定到位,而柔软可调节的三重法兰茎在耳道上提供安全密封。 低调的设计意味着 EP4s 可以在佩戴头盔或面罩时佩戴,或使用手机或耳机时佩戴。 有透明、黑色或橙色可选。 舒适的 EP4 Sonic Defenders Plus 还可以作为兼容无线电通信系统的耳塞,只需移除降噪过滤器并将耳塞连接到系统即可。 注意:一旦移除降噪滤波器,EP4 耳机将不再提供听力保护。

EP4 소닉 디펜더 플러스는 일상적인 소리나 대화를 듣는 능력을 방해하지 않으면서 청력을 보호합니다. 3중 플랜지 줄기 디자인은 보다 큰 외이도에도 딱 맞으며 24dB의 소음 감소 등급(NRR)을 제공합니다. 안전한 수준의 소리는 외이도를 통해 들어갈 수 있으며, 잠재적으로 유해한 소음(85dB 이상)은 특수 소음 감소 필터를 통합한 독점적인 디자인을 통해 감소됩니다. EP4에는 부착된 필터 캡이 포함되어 있어 추가적인 보호를 위해 삽입할 수 있으며 주변 소리 또는 대화가 중요하지 않은 상황에서는 비행기에서 들을 수 있는 것과 같은 낮은 수준의 소음을 차단합니다. 오른쪽/왼쪽 색상 표시된 소닉 디펜더 플러스는 부드럽지만 내구성이 뛰어난 저자극성 폴리머로 만들어져 하루 종일 편안함을 제공하며 제품 수명을 연장합니다(사용 및 관리에 따라 최대 6개월 이상). 특허 받은 EarLock 고정 링은 이어플러그를 제자리에 고정시키고, 부드럽고 조절 가능한 3중 플랜지 줄기는 외이도를 단단히 밀봉합니다. 눈에 띄지 않는 디자인으로 헬멧이나 마스크를 착용하는 동안이나 휴대폰이나 헤드셋을 사용하는 동안 EP4를 착용할 수 있습니다. 투명, 블랙 또는 오렌지 색상으로 제공됩니다. 편안한 EP4 소닉 디펜더 플러스는 소음 감소 필터를 제거하고 이어피스를 시스템에 부착하기만 하면 호환되는 무선 통신 시스템의 이어피스로 사용할 수 있습니다. 주의사항: 소음 감소 필터를 제거하면 EP4 이어피스가 더 이상 청력 보호 기능을 제공하지 않습니다.

description:
If you work in the military or law enforcement, getting exposed to the noise of gunshots and artillery shots is a fact of life. Unfortunately, this “fact of life” can lead to hearing loss in the long run —and even right away, depending on where you’re stationed. The American Speech Language Hearing Association points out that exposure to 140 dB which is less that almost all firearms can result in permanent hearing damage.

Reduce Harmful Noise While Maintaining Sound Directionality

To prevent this from happening, you should wear noise attenuating hearing protectors like the Earmonix Shooting Earplugs. They are specially designed to protect the wearer from the noise made by gunshots, explosions, and artillery shots. These ear plugs are designed for outdoor shooting and if used for indoor shooting ranges double protection is always recommended.

The Earmonix Shooting Earplugs are specially designed to protect your ears while still allowing you to hear what’s going on in your environment. Retaining sound spatiality and directionality are critical in military and law enforcement work to maintain alertness. When there is no high-impulse noise present they provide a NRR rated 12dB of continuous protection allowing you to hear background noise as well as the voices of the people around you. However with loud sound bursts such as firearms or explosions their specially designed reactive filters can provide up to 33dB of attenuation reducing dangerous sounds to a safe level. 

Convenient and Useful in Many Work Places

These ear plugs also work great for protection from many high impulse noises such as pneumatic power tools used in automotive and machining or even nail guns used in construction. However their reactive filters are not designed for work places with constant loud noise levels. They also come with a handy carry case with keyring or the slim design is perfect to just slip in your pocket.

description:
More than 40 years ago this simple hearing protector, the world’s first foam ear plug, revolutionized hearing protection in the workplace and has remained to this day one of the most widely used earplugs in the world. The 3M E-A-R Classic Ear Plugs are constructed from slow-recovery, low-pressure foam. They fit snugly to create a noise barrier that helps protect hearing from loud sounds. These ear plugs are stiff enough when compressed to make fitting easy, yet soft enough to be comfortable in the ear for extended wear. Bright yellow color allows supervisors to conduct quick visual hearing protection compliance checks. Recommended applications include chipping, chiseling, drilling, furnace operations, grinding, heavy equipment operations, machining, pouring/casting, power fastening, riveting, sanding, sawing and welding. These earplugs are commonly used in the following industries: agriculture, automotive, chemicals, construction, general manufacturing, healthcare, oil and gas, and pharmaceuticals. These ear plugs have a Noise Reduction Rating (NRR) of 29 dB, CSA Class AL.* Can be fit tested with the 3M E-A-Rfit Validation System. Moisture resistance helps maintain a consistent fit, even when humidity is present. Not only is noise present in our daily routines, but millions of Americans work in hazardous noise on a daily basis. Estimates from the National Institutes of Health suggest that approximately 15 percent of Americans (26 million people) between the ages of 20 and 69 have high frequency hearing loss due to exposure to noise at work or during leisure activities. Hearing loss due to noise is almost entirely preventable by consistent use of hearing protection.* Note: 3M strongly recommends fit testing of hearing protectors. Research suggests that many users will receive less noise reduction than indicated by the NRR due to variation in hearing protector fit, fitting skill, and motivation of the user. If the NRR is used, 3M recommends that it be reduced by 50% or in accordance with applicable regulations. description:
YS INDUSTRIES BRINGS TO THE MARKET GREAT QUALITY PRODUCT How to Use Soft Foam Ear Plugs

To get the best protection from your soft foam earplugs, remember to roll, pull, and hold when putting them in. Use clean hands to keep from getting dirt and germs into your ears! 1. Roll

Roll the earplug up into a small, thin "snake" with your fingers. You can use one or both hands. 2. Pull

Pull the top of your ear up and back with your opposite hand to straighten out your ear canal. The rolled-up earplug should slide right in. 3. Hold

Hold the earplug in with your finger. Count to 20 or 30 out loud while waiting for the plug to expand and fill the ear canal. Your voice will sound muffled when the plug has made a good seal.

Check the fit when you're all done. Most of the foam body of the earplug should be within the ear canal. Try cupping your hands tightly over your ears. If sounds are much more muffled with your hands in place, the earplug may not be sealing properly. Take the earplug out and try again.

description: Etymotic, your trusted source in high-fidelity hearing protection has created Music-PRO 9-15 electronic earplugs, adaptive noise reduction earplugs that automatically adjust to changing sound levels. Music-PRO 9-15 provide the ultimate in hearing protection. You'll experience natural hearing when sound levels are safe and sound reduction that activates only when needed. From pianissimo to fortissimo, music sounds natural. Music-PRO 9-15 earplugs were designed for musicians who want to hear naturally but need protection from sudden impact noise and loud, sustained passages. They are ideal for directors and music educators, preforming musicians - especially symphony and jazz, front-of-house crews, entertainment industry support staff, security personnel, and audiences. Music-PRO 9-15 uses adaptive noise reduction technology - the circuitry automatically changes output levels as sound input levels change. Hearing is natural, as if nothing is in the ears, until sound exceeds safe levels. As sound levels increase, earplugs gradually provide 9- or 15-dB sound reduction. Natural hearing is restored when sound returns to safe levels. There's no need to remove your earplugs to hear. Music-PRO earplugs offer two modes of operation. First, Natural Hearing with 15-dB Sound Reduction provides natural hearing until sound exceeds safe levels, then automatically adjusting to 15-dB protection. Or, you can choose Enhanced Hearing mode, which provides 6-dB gain for soft sounds and then automatic 9-dB protection when sound exceeds safe levels. Both modes provide impact sound protection. Music-PRO earphones come ready to use with an assortment of ACCU-Fit ear tips, custom molds are not required. Also included with purchase: flexible neck cord, filter tool and ACCU-filters, cleaning tool, batteries (#10A zinc air), protective case and user manual.

description:
What is PEAK ATP?

PEAK ATP is a clinically validated and patented form of Adenosine 5’- Triphosphate (ATP) Disodium shown to improve body composition and athletic performance by increasing muscular excitability, blood flow and recovery.*

How does PEAK ATP work?

PEAK ATP helps to optimize athletic performance through three distinct mechanisms of action: 1) ATP increases muscular excitability resulting in significant gains in strength and power, 2) ATP increases blood flow, resulting in improved oxygen and nutrient delivery to the muscle and 3) ATP is involved in anabolic signaling, resulting in increased lean body mass and muscle thickness.*

What is Muscular Excitability?

Muscular excitability refers to the ability to activate muscle, thereby causing it to contract. The greater the excitability of the muscle the greater its force, velocity, and endurance properties will be. Muscle is excited by the release of calcium into the cell. Calcium serves as the trigger for contraction. Peak ATP works by increasing and sustaining the amount of calcium available to the muscle, which boosts muscular excitability. The result is the athlete will lift greater weights and produce a greater number of repetitions per set.

How does PEAK ATP Improve Blood Flow?

Red blood cells release ATP into the blood when muscles are fatigued, causing vasodilation to occur. PEAK ATP supplementation increases the amount of ATP available in red blood cells. As a result of more ATP being available, significant increases in blood flow, oxygen delivery and clearance of metabolic waste products such as lactate are obtained.

Design: The flanges are contoured / wave shaped - each flange has two crests and two troughs around the edge. This optimizes the distribution of material inside the ear canal to form an optimized seal and applies the least amount of pressure to delicate ear canal tissues. It’s a natural fit with optimized performance.

Filter Technology: Our current filter technology allows a precise amount of unobstructed sound into the ear. The filters are precision injected ABS plastic. The DEC filters contain tuned acoustic membrane and mesh layers that act as a primary eardrum. Sound hits these layers and the sound signature is precisely replicated at the performance rating of the filter - e.g. a 15dB filter replicates the sound 15dB lower than the environment. The experience is true to life sound at a safe comfortable level.

description:
If you work in the military or law enforcement, getting exposed to the noise of gunshots and artillery shots is a fact of life. Unfortunately, this “fact of life” can lead to hearing loss in the long run —and even right away, depending on where you’re stationed. The American Speech Language Hearing Association points out that exposure to 140 dB which is less that almost all firearms can result in permanent hearing damage.

Reduce Harmful Noise While Maintaining Sound Directionality

To prevent this from happening, you should wear noise attenuating hearing protectors like the Earmonix Shooting Earplugs. They are specially designed to protect the wearer from the noise made by gunshots, explosions, and artillery shots. These ear plugs are designed for outdoor shooting and if used for indoor shooting ranges double protection is always recommended.

The Earmonix Shooting Earplugs are specially designed to protect your ears while still allowing you to hear what’s going on in your environment. Retaining sound spatiality and directionality are critical in military and law enforcement work to maintain alertness. When there is no high-impulse noise present they provide a NRR rated 12dB of continuous protection allowing you to hear background noise as well as the voices of the people around you. However with loud sound bursts such as firearms or explosions their specially designed reactive filters can provide up to 33dB of attenuation reducing dangerous sounds to a safe level. 

Convenient and Useful in Many Work Places

These ear plugs also work great for protection from many high impulse noises such as pneumatic power tools used in automotive and machining or even nail guns used in construction. However their reactive filters are not designed for work places with constant loud noise levels. They also come with a handy carry case with keyring or the slim design is perfect to just slip in your pocket.

Filter Out Noise, Not The Experience

As a hunter, gun enthusiast, or motorcycle rider, you're exposed to high dB sounds while doing your favorite activities. These sounds are harmful - the American Speech Language Hearing Association points out that exposure to 140 dB sounds can result in permanent hearing damage - but the only solutions thus far have been earplugs that block all sound at the expense of lower dB noise. 

SonoPro Sport's patent-pending technology changes that by allowing lower volume sound to be filtered through with no distortion (think conversation, game noise, etc.) while blocking higher volume sounds such as gunshots. 

Developed With the Military in Mind

We started developing SonoPro Sport over seven years ago for law enforcement and military use. In these high-risk environments, military and law enforcement need to be able to hear low-volume sounds with absolutely no distortion or lack of directionality. We're releasing this technology to the public for the first time so you can have the same technology at your back while hunting or on the gun range. 

Comfort Comes First

You don't have to sacrifice utility for comfort. SonoPro Sport is designed with a low-profile and soft, triple flange outer layer to provide all-day comfort. If you need ear warmers or earmuffs, SonoPro Sport does not extend past the surface of the ear, meaning you can add additional layers for warmth without sacrificing performance.

Aside from the stress of planning your itinerary and packing your bags, you’ll have to deal with airplane air, which is caused by the imbalance of air pressure inside and outside the ears and makes you feel pain. Fortunately, we’ve created a solution for you: the Earmonix Flying & Travel Earplugs. These noise-reducing earplugs are specially designed to regulate the change in air pressure between the cabin and your ear, allowing you to avoid ear pain during takeoffs and landings. The advanced membrane filter design with its 17dB SNR rating and 10dB NRR rating also reduces background noise while allowing speech and flight announcements to be heard more clearly.

Convenient to Carry and Easy to Clean

One of the best things about the Earmonix Flying & Travel Earplugs is that they come with a slim carry case, so they won’t add any more bulk to your luggage and you can easily slip them in your purse or pocket. They’re also easy to clean: simply wipe them with a damp cloth or antibacterial cleaning tissues after using, and they’re ready to go! You can wash them with mild soap and water once you get home from the trip to get them ready for your next travels.

Great for Everyday Use

You don’t even have to go on a plane to use the Earmonix Flying & Travel Earplugs! If you’re riding in a car, bus or train, or staying at a noisy hotel, you can pull out your earplugs, tune out the noise around you, and enjoy a nap or a good night’s sleep.

description: Doc's ProPlugs can prevent swimmers ear, and ear pain by blocking water from entering the ears, keeping ears warm and preventing the flushing of water in and out of the ear. Due to surface tension the vented plug also reduces abrupt pressure changes from reaching the sensitive eardrum which contributes to easier equalization. Clear ears often to allow air to escape through the ProPlugs vent and allow for better equalization. ProPlug wearers who have trouble clearing their ears should check to make sure a lump of ear wax is not blocking the canal or butting up against the vent. If the vent is fouled by debris while descending it is best to remove the ProPlug. If fouled while ascending, there is no problem because the air and water under pressure can escape around the ProPlug.Hundreds of divers have attested to the benefits of ProPlugs for relieving pressure in their ear during descent.

WHAT IS NOISE REDUCTION RATING (NRR)?
A noise reduction rating indicates the level of sound that earplugs block out when used without simultaneous noise-blocking objects. This rating applies only to earplugs and earmuffs and provides users of these devices an important analytical tool when comparison shopping.
NRR Ratings
The highest NRR rating for earplugs is 33dB, and the highest available NRR rating for earmuffs is 31dB. These values reflect the level of noise protection available for each device when worn alone. Combining earplugs with earmuffs can offer a NRR protection level of 36dB. Manufacturers produce different types of earplugs and earmuffs to reach these ratings. Generally, higher-quality devices that cost more receive a higher NRR rating.

ZEM Sound Reduction Chamber Technology — How It Works.
The patented ZEM Sound Reduction Chamber Technology combines physics with physiological precision. Soft earbuds of the SensGard form a seal around the ear canal channeling sound through its unique Reduction Chambers. Since sound energy travels the path of least resistance, high-intensity sounds, like gunfire, funnel into the wider Sound Reduction Chambers and away from narrower ear canals. The chamber instantly dampens, refracts and effectively cancels harmful waves to produce a safe volume across all frequencies so you can hear important sounds or communication without ever removing your SensGard.

University Developed. Backed by Science.

*Limit time spent engaging in noisy activities

description:
Hearing loss from loud sound affects millions of people, but noise-induced hearing loss is preventable! ER20XS high-fidelity earplugs reduce sound levels while preserving sound quality and clarity. ER20XS earplugs are configured to replicate the natural response of the ear, so sound quality is the same as the original, only quieter. Music, voices and other sounds are clear--not muffled--making ER20XS ideal for concerts, clubs, theaters, aircraft, construction, yard work, airshows, parades, and athletic or motorsports events. The new low-profile, stem-less design fits snugly in the outer ear without protruding, making ER20XS comfortable to wear under hats, helmets, and other headgear. The standard-size eartips fit the majority of ears. ER20XS earplugs are reusable, but with repeated use, the eartips may lose elasticity. For best performance and retention, if you use your ER20XS earplugs frequently, replace the eartips every 3-6 months. ER20XS are not recommended for use with impulse noises such as gunfire, or for sleeping.

description:
EP7 Sonic Defenders Ultra protect your hearing without interfering with your ability to hear routine sounds or conversations. Their foam-tipped stem design, featuring soft memory-foam Comply Canal Tips, fits most people and provides a Noise Reduction Rating (NRR) of 28dB. Sounds, at safe levels, are allowed to pass through into the ear canal, while potentially harmful noises (above 85dB) are reduced via a proprietary design that incorporates a special noise-reducing filter. EP7s include attached filter caps, which can be inserted for additional protection and blocking out lower-level noise, like that heard on a plane, in situations where hearing ambient sounds or conversations isn't critical. The right/left color-coded Sonic Defenders Ultra are made from a soft but durable, hypoallergenic polymer and are ergonomically shaped, providing a secure fit, all-day comfort, and extended product life (up to 6+ months, depending on usage and care). And their low-profile design means they can be worn while wearing a helmet or mask, or while using a phone or headset. Comfortable EP7 Sonic Defenders Ultra also serve as earpieces for compatible radio communication systems simply by removing the noise-reducing filter and attaching the earpiece to the system. NOTE: EP7 earpiece will not provide hearing protection if the noise-reducing filter is removed.

EP7 소닉 디펜더 울트라는 일상적인 소리나 대화를 듣는 능력을 방해하지 않으면서 청력을 보호합니다. 폼 팁 스템 디자인은 부드러운 메모리 폼 컴플라이 커널 팁이 특징이며, 대부분의 사람들에게 적합하며 28dB의 소음 감소 등급(NRR)을 제공합니다. 안전한 수준에서 사운드는 외이도로 통과할 수 있으며, 잠재적으로 유해한 소음(85dB 이상)은 특수 소음 감소 필터를 통합하는 독점적인 디자인을 통해 감소됩니다. EP7에는 주변 소리 또는 대화를 듣는 것이 중요하지 않은 상황에서 비행기에서 들리는 것과 같은 낮은 수준의 소음을 차단하기 위해 삽입할 수 있는 부착된 필터 캡이 포함되어 있습니다. 오른쪽/왼쪽 색상 코드 Sonic Defenders Ultra는 부드럽지만 내구성이 뛰어난 저자극성 폴리머로 만들어졌으며 인체 공학적 모양으로 안전한 착용감, 하루 종일 편안함, 제품 수명을 연장합니다 (사용 및 관리에 따라 최대 6개월 이상). 로우 프로파일 디자인으로 헬멧이나 마스크를 착용하거나 휴대폰이나 헤드셋을 사용할 때 착용할 수 있습니다. 편안한 EP7 소닉 디펜더 울트라는 소음 감소 필터를 제거하고 이어피스를 시스템에 부착하기만 하면 호환 무선 통신 시스템의 이어피스로 사용할 수 있습니다. 참고: 소음 감소 필터를 제거하면 EP7 이어피스가 청력 보호 기능을 제공하지 않습니다.

O EP7 Sonic Defenders Ultra protege sua audição sem interferir na sua capacidade de ouvir sons ou conversas de rotina. Seu design de haste com ponta de espuma, com espuma de memória macia em conformidade com as pontas canais, adapta-se à maioria das pessoas e oferece uma Classificação de Redução de Ruído (NRR) de 28 dB. Os sons, em níveis seguros, podem passar pelo canal auditivo, enquanto os ruídos potencialmente prejudiciais (acima de 85 dB) são reduzidos através de um design exclusivo que incorpora um filtro especial de redução de ruído. Os EP7s incluem tampas de filtro anexadas, que podem ser inseridas para proteção adicional e bloqueio de ruído de nível mais baixo, como aquele ouvido em um avião, em situações em que ouvir sons ou conversas do ambiente não é fundamental. Os Sonic Defenders Ultra codificados por cor direita/esquerda são feitos de um polímero macio, mas durável, hipoalergênico que oferece conforto durante todo o dia e uma vida útil prolongada do produto (até 6 meses ou mais, dependendo do uso e cuidado). Seus anéis de retenção EarLock patenteados travam os tampões de ouvido no lugar, enquanto hastes macias com ponta de espuma fornecem vedações seguras nos canais auditivos. E seu design discreto significa que eles podem ser usados enquanto estiver usando um capacete ou máscara, ou enquanto estiver usando um telefone ou fone de ouvido. Disponível em transparente, preto ou laranja. O confortável EP7 Sonic Defenders Ultra também serve como fone de ouvido para sistemas de comunicação de rádio compatíveis, basta remover o filtro de redução de ruído e fixar o fone de ouvido ao sistema. * Compatibilidade com sistema de comunicação de rádio: Thales: arnês de segurança discreto; Harris: conjunto de comunicação da força de segurança; Motorola: kits de vigilância; indústrias de comando tático: produtos de fone de ouvido; peltor: sistemas leves de fone de ouvido; Silynx: Fone de ouvido C4Ops. title: Sanohra Fly (Regular) - Pressure and Noise Sound reducing Ear Plugs for Flying - Against Airplanes Ear
bullet_point: [Have a safe flight, use SANOHRA fly earplugs, Relieves inflight ear discomfort, Relieves air pressure discomfort with exclusive filter, Filter regulates air pressure and noises, More flights with 6 flight segments]
description:
SANOHRA fly ear plugs

More than half of all air passengers know the uncomfortable pressure feeling or pain in the ear that can occur during air travel, especially while landing. The ear is a very sensitive organ. The middle ear, which is located behind the eardrum, is airtight. When the air pressure in the aircraft cabin rapidly increases while landing, a relative low pressure is created in the middle ear.

SANOHRA fly ear plugs, have been specifically designed to protect the ear against rapid and excessive changes in air pressure. A pressure regulator, which has been integrated into the earplug, regulates and slows down the pressure changes in front of the eardrum.

 

SANOHRA fly ear plugs protects the ear

SANOHRA fly ear plugs are put in 45 minutes before landing. The cabin pressure that rapidly increases in a few minutes is slowed down and increases gradually in front of the eardrum. Thus, the Eustachian tube gets more time to aerate the middle ear, even with restricted functionality, before ear pain sets in.

 

Tested at the Charité hospital in Berlin/Germany

In the first systematic and prospective study at the ENT Clinic at the Charité Mitte campus, a select group of test subjects who were known to have ear problems while flying, were studied in a pressure chamber. In the process, a significant reduction in the pain sensation could be demonstrated using the filter by delaying the change in pressure.

 

SANOHRA fly ear plugs made in Germany

description:
More than 40 years ago this simple hearing protector, the world’s first foam ear plug, revolutionized hearing protection in the workplace and has remained to this day one of the most widely used earplugs in the world. The 3M E-A-R Classic Ear Plugs OCS1137 are constructed from slow-recovery, low-pressure foam. They fit snugly to create a noise barrier that helps protect hearing from loud sounds. These ear plugs are stiff enough when compressed to make fitting easy, yet soft enough to be comfortable in the ear for extended wear. Bright yellow color allows supervisors to conduct quick visual hearing protection compliance checks. Recommended applications include chipping, chiseling, drilling, furnace operations, grinding, heavy equipment operations, machining, pouring/casting, power fastening, riveting, sanding, sawing and welding. These earplugs are commonly used in the following industries: agriculture, automotive, chemicals, construction, general manufacturing, healthcare, oil and gas, and pharmaceuticals. These regular size earplugs comfortably fit most people. These ear plugs have a Noise Reduction Rating (NRR) of 29 dB, CSA Class AL. These earplugs can be fit tested with the 3M E-A-Rfit Validation System. Moisture resistance helps maintain a consistent fit, even when humidity is present. Not only is noise present in our daily routines, but millions of Americans work in hazardous noise on a daily basis. Estimates from the National Institutes of Health suggest that approximately 15 percent of Americans (26 million people) between the ages of 20 and 69 have high frequency hearing loss due to exposure to noise at work or during leisure activities. Hearing loss due to noise is almost entirely preventable by consistent use of hearing protection. Note: 3M strongly recommends fit testing of hearing protectors. Research suggests that many users will receive less noise reduction than indicated by the NRR due to variation in hearing protector fit, fitting skill, and motivation of the user. If the NRR is used, 3M recommends that it be reduced by 50% or in accordance with applicable regulations. description:
The best earplugs are the one you'll want to wear and actually use. Featuring an advanced acoustic filter and volume slider, dBud is an ear plug designed to protect your ears from harmful noise while giving you a crisper, clearer listening experience. With the slide of a button you can adjust the amount of decibels you want to filter out, allowing you to set the appropriate sound level for your environment. dBud simply brings you clear, safe sound!

THE OPEN SETTING
The acoustic filter is designed to alter the attenuation curve so that it let’s frequencies of typical human speech through with less reduction, while other frequencies are reduced to a higher degree. This means that background noise is toned down, while you’re still being able to hear and communicate with people around you.

THE CLOSED SETTING
The usual problem with earplugs is that they kill both the volume and the sound. Uneven attenuation across high and low tones leads to a muffled and distorted sound.dBud is different. The closed setting has a very flat attenuation of around 30dB across the entire frequency spectrum. This means less distortion of the sound coming through to your ear, and it gives you the clearest possible sound experience, with significantly reduced volume.

EarPeace PRO is our next generation ear plug and is differentiated with a completely new design and custom high performance filters provided by DEC (Dynamic Ear Company) based in Delft, Holland. (design and utility patents pending)

EarPeace PRO is designed to maximize comfort and performance through two major design changes. The ear canal is oblong and the plug itself is also oblong vs. the current round design.

Design: The flanges are contoured / wave shaped - each flange has two crests and two troughs around the edge. This optimizes the distribution of material inside the ear canal to form an optimized seal and applies the least amount of pressure to delicate ear canal tissues. It’s a natural fit with optimized performance.

Filter Technology: Our current filter technology allows a precise amount of unobstructed sound into the ear. The filters are precision injected ABS plastic. The DEC filters contain tuned acoustic membrane and mesh layers that act as a primary eardrum. Sound hits these layers and the sound signature is precisely replicated at the performance rating of the filter - e.g. a 15dB filter replicates the sound 15dB lower than the environment. The experience is true to life sound at a safe comfortable level.

title: SureFire EP4 Sonic Defenders Plus filtered Earplugs, triple flanged design, reusable, Black, Large
bullet_point: [24dB Noise Reduction Rating (NRR) with filter caps inserted, Hear safe sound levels (with filter caps out) as if you weren't wearing ear plugs, Soft, adjustable, triple-flanged stems provide secure seals in ear canals and all-day comfort, Low-profile design allows you to keep them in place while wearing a mask, helmet, hat, or while using supplemental hearing muffs, Patented EarLock retention rings utilize seven contact points to lock earpieces in place and fit the same way every time, Made in USA from hypoallergenic, medical-grade polymer that's soft, durable, and long-lasting]
description:
EP4 Sonic Defenders Plus protect your hearing without interfering with your ability to hear routine sounds or conversations. Their triple-flanged stem design fits larger ear canals and provides a Noise Reduction Rating (NRR) of 24dB. Sounds, at safe levels, are allowed to pass through into the ear canal, while potentially harmful noises (above 85dB) are reduced via a proprietary design that incorporates a special noise-reducing filter. EP4s include attached filter caps, which can be inserted for additional protection and blocking out lower-level noise, like that heard on a plane, where hearing ambient sounds or conversations isn't critical. Right/left color-coded Sonic Defenders Plus are made from a soft but durable, hypoallergenic polymer that provides all-day comfort and an extended product life (up to 6+ months, depending on usage and care). Their patented EarLock retention rings lock the earplugs in place, while soft, adjustable triple-flanged stems provide secure seals in the ear canals. A low-profile design means EP4s can be worn while wearing a helmet or mask, or while using a phone or headset. Available in clear, black, or orange. Comfortable EP4 Sonic Defenders Plus also serve as earpieces for compatible radio communication systems simply by removing the noise-reducing filter and attaching the earpiece to the system. NOTE: EP4 earpiece no longer provides hearing protection once the noise-reducing filter has been removed.

EP4 Sonic Defenders Plus מגנים על השמיעה שלכם מבלי להפריע ליכולת שלכם לשמוע צלילים או שיחות שגרתיות. עיצוב הגבעול המשולש שלהם מתאים לתעלות אוזניים גדולות יותר ומספק דירוג הפחתת רעש (NRR) של 24dB. צלילים, ברמות בטוחות, מותרים לעבור דרך תעלת האוזן, בעוד רעשים שעלולים להיות מזיקים (מעל 85dB) מופחתים באמצעות עיצוב קנייני המשלב מסנן מיוחד להפחתת רעשים. EP4s כוללים מכסי פילטר מחוברים, אשר ניתנים להכנסה להגנה נוספת וחסימת רעש ברמה נמוכה יותר, כמו שנשמע במטוס, שבו שמיעת צלילי סביבה או שיחות אינה קריטית. Sonic Defenders Plus מקודד בצבע ימין / שמאל עשויים מפולימר היפואלרגני רך אך עמיד, המספק נוחות לאורך כל היום וחיי מוצר ארוכים (עד 6 חודשים ומעלה, בהתאם לשימוש ולטיפול). טבעות השימור EarLock הרשומות כפטנט שלהן נועלות את אטמי האוזניים במקום, בעוד גבעולים רכים ומתכווננים בעלי שלוש אגזומים מאובטחים בתעלות האוזן. עיצוב פרופיל נמוך פירושו שניתן ללבוש EP4s בזמן לבישת קסדה או מסכה, או תוך שימוש בטלפון או באוזניות. זמין בצבע שקוף, שחור או כתום. מגיני EP4 Sonic Defender Plus נוחים משמשים גם כאוזניות למערכות תקשורת רדיו תואמות פשוט על ידי הסרת המסנן המפחית רעש והצמדת האוזניה למערכת. הערה: אוזניות EP4 כבר לא מספקות הגנה על השמיעה לאחר הסרת המסנן המפחית רעשים.

EP4 Sonic Defenders Plus schützt Ihr Gehör ohne Ihre Fähigkeit zu stören, Routine-Sounds oder Gespräche zu hören. Das dreifach geflanschte Design passt auf größere Gehörgänge und bietet eine Geräuschreduzierung von 24 dB. Geräusche, auf sicheren Ebenen, werden in den Gehörgang gelassen, während potenziell schädliche Geräusche (über 85 dB) durch ein proprietäres Design reduziert werden, das einen speziellen geräuschreduzierenden Filter enthält. EP4s enthalten angebrachte Filterkappen, die für zusätzlichen Schutz eingesetzt werden können und niedrigere Geräusche blockieren, wie das im Flugzeug gehört wird, wo Umgebungsgeräusche oder Gespräche nicht entscheidend sind. Rechts/links farbcodierte Sonic Defenders Plus sind aus einem weichen, aber langlebigen, hypoallergenen Polymer, das ganztägigen Komfort und eine verlängerte Produktlebensdauer (bis zu 6+ Monate, je nach Nutzung und Pflege). Die patentierten EarLock-Ringe halten die Ohrstöpsel an Ort und Stelle, während weiche, verstellbare Dreifach-Flansch-Stiele für sichere Abdichtungen in den Gehörgängen sorgen. Ein flaches Design bedeutet, dass EP4s beim Tragen eines Helms oder einer Maske oder während der Verwendung eines Telefons oder Headsets getragen werden können. Erhältlich in Transparent, Schwarz oder Orange. Komfortable EP4 Sonic Defenders Plus dienen auch als Ohrhörer für kompatible Funkkommunikationssysteme, indem Sie einfach den geräuschreduzierenden Filter entfernen und den Ohrhörer am System befestigen. Hinweis: EP4-Ohrhörer bieten keinen Gehörschutz mehr, wenn der geräuschreduzierende Filter entfernt wurde.

يحمي جهاز الحماية سونيك اي بي 4 بلس سماعك دون التداخل مع قدرتك على سماع الأصوات أو المحادثات الروتينية. تصميم الجذع ثلاثي الحواف يناسب قنوات الأذن الأكبر ويوفر معدل خفض الضوضاء (NRR) يبلغ 24 ديسيبل. يسمح بمرور الأصوات، بمستويات آمنة، إلى قناة الأذن، بينما يتم تقليل الضوضاء المحتملة (أعلى من 85 ديسيبل) من خلال تصميم خاص يتضمن فلتر خاص لتقليل الضوضاء. تتضمن EP4s أغطية فلتر مرفقة، والتي يمكن إدراجها لحماية إضافية ومنع الضوضاء المنخفضة، مثل تلك التي سمعت على الطائرة، حيث لا يكون من الضروري سماع الأصوات أو المحادثات المحيطة. تم صنع جهاز سونيك ديفيندرز بلس المرمز بالألوان اليمينة/اليسرى من البوليمر الناعم والمتين والمضاد للحساسية والذي يوفر الراحة طوال اليوم وعمر افتراضي طويل للمنتج (حتى 6 أشهر فما فوق، حسب الاستخدام والعناية). تعمل حلقات تثبيت الأذن الحاصلة على براءة اختراع على تثبيت سدادات الأذن في مكانها، بينما توفر السيقان الناعمة القابلة للتعديل ذات الحافة الثلاثية سدادات آمنة في قنوات الأذن. تصميم بسيط يعني أنه يمكن ارتداء EP4s أثناء ارتداء خوذة أو قناع أو أثناء استخدام الهاتف أو سماعة الرأس. متوفر باللون الشفاف أو الأسود أو البرتقالي. كما تعمل سماعات الرأس الصوتية EP4 Sonic Defenders Plus المريحة أيضًا كسماعات أذن لأنظمة الاتصال اللاسلكي المتوافقة ببساطة عن طريق إزالة فلتر تقليل الضوضاء وتوصيل سماعة الأذن بالنظام. ملاحظة: لم تعد سماعة الأذن EP4 توفر حماية للسمع بمجرد إزالة فلتر تقليل الضوضاء.

EP4 Sonic Defenders Plus 保護您的聽力,不會妨礙您聆聽日常聲音或對話的能力。 三法蘭桿設計適合較大的耳道,並提供24分貝的降噪等級 (NRR)。 安全級別的聲音可以通過耳道,而潛在的有害噪音 (高於 85 分貝)可通過專利設計,採用特殊的降噪過濾器來降低。 EP4s 包括附帶的濾波器蓋,可以插入以提供額外的保護和阻擋低級噪聲,就像在飛機上聽到的聲音,在那裡聽到的環境聲音或對話不是重要的。 左右顏色編碼的 Sonic Defenders Plus 採用柔軟耐用的低過敏性聚合物製成,提供全天的舒適感和延長產品壽命(長達 6 個月以上,取決於使用和保養)。 其獲得專利的 EarLock 固定環將耳塞固定到位,而柔軟、可調節的三法蘭桿可在耳道中提供安全的密封。 低調設計意味著 EP4 可以戴著頭盔或面具,或使用手機或耳機時佩戴。 有透明、黑色或橘色可供選擇。 舒適的 EP4 Sonic Defenders Plus 還可用作兼容無線電通訊系統的耳機,只需移除降噪過濾器並將耳機連接到系統上。 注意:一旦降噪濾鏡移除,EP4 耳機就不再提供聽力保護。

EP4 Sonic Defenders Plus 可在不影响您听到日常声音或对话的能力的情况下保护您的听觉。 它们的三重法兰杆设计适合较大的耳道,并提供降噪等级 (NRR) 为 24dB。 安全级别的声音允许通过耳道,同时通过带有特殊降噪滤波器的专有设计减少潜在有害噪音(85 分贝以上)。 EP4s 包括附加的过滤盖,可以插入以提供额外的保护,并阻挡较低水平的噪音,就像在飞机上听到的声音,在那里听到的环境声音或对话并不重要。 右/左颜色编码的 Sonic Defenders Plus 由柔软但耐用的低过敏性聚合物制成,提供全天的舒适性和延长产品寿命(长达 6 个月,取决于使用情况和护理情况)。 获得专利的 EarLock 固定环将耳塞锁定到位,而柔软可调节的三重法兰茎在耳道上提供安全密封。 低调的设计意味着 EP4s 可以在佩戴头盔或面罩时佩戴,或使用手机或耳机时佩戴。 有透明、黑色或橙色可选。 舒适的 EP4 Sonic Defenders Plus 还可以作为兼容无线电通信系统的耳塞,只需移除降噪过滤器并将耳塞连接到系统即可。 注意:一旦移除降噪滤波器,EP4 耳机将不再提供听力保护。

EP4 소닉 디펜더 플러스는 일상적인 소리나 대화를 듣는 능력을 방해하지 않으면서 청력을 보호합니다. 3중 플랜지 줄기 디자인은 보다 큰 외이도에도 딱 맞으며 24dB의 소음 감소 등급(NRR)을 제공합니다. 안전한 수준의 소리는 외이도를 통해 들어갈 수 있으며, 잠재적으로 유해한 소음(85dB 이상)은 특수 소음 감소 필터를 통합한 독점적인 디자인을 통해 감소됩니다. More than 40 years ago this simple hearing protector, the world’s first foam ear plug, revolutionized hearing protection in the workplace and has remained to this day one of the most widely used ear plugs in the world. The 3M E-A-R Classic Super fit Ear Plugs come with an orange “fitting ring” that provides a guideline to show when the earplugs are properly inserted for optimal hearing protection. These ear plugs are stiff enough when compressed to make fitting easy, yet soft enough to be comfortable in the ear for extended wear. Bright yellow colour with the orange fitting ring allows supervisors to conduct a quick visual hearing protection compliance check. Recommended applications include chipping, chiselling, drilling, furnace operations, grinding, heavy equipment operations, machining, pouring/casting, power fastening, riveting, sanding, sawing and welding. These earplugs are commonly used in the following industries: agriculture, automotive, chemicals, construction, general manufacturing, healthcare, oil and gas, and pharmaceuticals. Moisture resistance helps maintain a consistent fit, even when humidity is present. Not only is noise present in our daily routines, but millions of Americans work in hazardous noise on a daily basis. Estimates from the National Institutes of Health suggest that approximately 15 percent of Americans (26 million people) between the ages of 20 and 69 have high frequency hearing loss due to exposure to noise at work or during leisure activities. Hearing loss due to noise is almost entirely preventable by consistent use of hearing protection. * Note: 3M strongly recommends fit testing of hearing protectors. Research suggests that many users will receive less noise reduction than indicated by the NRR due to variation in hearing protector fit, fitting skill, and motivation of the user. If the NRR is used, 3M recommends that it be reduced by 50% or in accordance with applicable regulations. description:
Filter Out Noise, Not The Experience

As a hunter, gun enthusiast, or motorcycle rider, you're exposed to high dB sounds while doing your favorite activities. These sounds are harmful - the American Speech Language Hearing Association points out that exposure to 140 dB sounds can result in permanent hearing damage - but the only solutions thus far have been earplugs that block all sound at the expense of lower dB noise. 

SonoPro Sport's patent-pending technology changes that by allowing lower volume sound to be filtered through with no distortion (think conversation, game noise, etc.) while blocking higher volume sounds such as gunshots. 

Developed With the Military in Mind

We started developing SonoPro Sport over seven years ago for law enforcement and military use. In these high-risk environments, military and law enforcement need to be able to hear low-volume sounds with absolutely no distortion or lack of directionality. We're releasing this technology to the public for the first time so you can have the same technology at your back while hunting or on the gun range. 

Comfort Comes First

You don't have to sacrifice utility for comfort. SonoPro Sport is designed with a low-profile and soft, triple flange outer layer to provide all-day comfort. If you need ear warmers or earmuffs, SonoPro Sport does not extend past the surface of the ear, meaning you can add additional layers for warmth without sacrificing performance. 

Sonopro Sport has also worked in loud musical environments such as concerts to lower the volume of the music...but does not distort or reduce the clarity!

How to Use Soft Foam Ear Plugs

To get the best protection from your soft foam earplugs, remember to roll, pull, and hold when putting them in. Use clean hands to keep from getting dirt and germs into your ears! 1. Roll

Roll the earplug up into a small, thin "snake" with your fingers. You can use one or both hands. 2. Pull

Pull the top of your ear up and back with your opposite hand to straighten out your ear canal. The rolled-up earplug should slide right in. 3. Hold

Hold the earplug in with your finger. Count to 20 or 30 out loud while waiting for the plug to expand and fill the ear canal. Your voice will sound muffled when the plug has made a good seal.

Check the fit when you're all done. Most of the foam body of the earplug should be within the ear canal. Try cupping your hands tightly over your ears. If sounds are much more muffled with your hands in place, the earplug may not be sealing properly. Take the earplug out and try again.
