description:
WHY USE EARPLUGS?
There are many situations in which a good pair of earplugs can help block out noise and/or protect your ears from particularly loud noises.
Sleeping
Many people have trouble sleeping because of noise. If you live in a noisy building, on a street with heavy traffic, or in a dorm, or you have a partner who snores, earplugs can help you get a good night’s rest. Earplugs are also a good option for individuals who work at night and sleep during the day.
Working
Whether you work in a noisy office or you’re a student trying to study in a busy dorm, earplugs can help you block out distractions so you can focus on the work you need to do.
Using equipment
If your job requires you to use power tools, lawn equipment, or other noisy appliances, or you use them around the house, earplugs can help protect your ears and prevent hearing loss.
Hunting/shooting
If you’re a hunter or regularly go target shooting, earplugs help protect your hearing from loud gunfire.
Listening to music
Whether you’re a musician who regularly practices and performs or a concert-goer with really good seats, your hearing can easily be compromised by loud amplified music. Earplugs can help prevent hearing loss.
Swimming
If you swim regularly, earplugs can keep water out of your ears and help prevent infection.
Flying
Traveling by air can cause pressure to build up in your ears with changes in cabin pressure. Earplugs can help keep your ears from popping or hurting when you fly.

description:
EPA INFORMATION:

The level of noise entering a person’s ear, when a hearing protector is worn as directed, is closely approximated by the difference between the A-weighted environmental noise level and the NRR.

Example:

1. The environmental noise level as measured at the ear is 92 dB(A).
2. The NRR is 33 decibels (dB).
3. The level of noise entering the ear is approximately equal to [92 dB(A) -33] 59 dB (A).
CAUTION: For noise environments dominated by frequencies below 500 Hz, the C-weighted environmental noise level should be used. Improper fit of this device will reduce its effectiveness in attenuating noise. Consult the enclosed instructions for proper fit. Although hearing protectors can be recommended for protection against the harmful effects of impulsive noise, the Noise Reduction Rating (NRR) is based on the attenuation of continuous noise and may not be an accurate indicator of the protection attainable against impulsive noise such as gunfire.

WHAT IS NOISE REDUCTION RATING (NRR)?
A noise reduction rating indicates the level of sound that earplugs block out when used without simultaneous noise-blocking objects. This rating applies only to earplugs and earmuffs and provides users of these devices an important analytical tool when comparison shopping.
NRR Ratings
The highest NRR rating for earplugs is 33dB, and the highest available NRR rating for earmuffs is 31dB. These values reflect the level of noise protection available for each device when worn alone. Combining earplugs with earmuffs can offer a NRR protection level of 36dB. Manufacturers produce different types of earplugs and earmuffs to reach these ratings. Generally, higher-quality devices that cost more receive a higher NRR rating.

Estes tampões de ouvido são rígidos o suficiente quando comprimidos para facilitar o ajuste, mas macios o suficiente para serem confortáveis no ouvido para uso prolongado. A cor amarela brilhante permite que os supervisores realizem verificações rápidas de conformidade com a proteção auditiva. Aplicações recomendadas incluem lascas, cinzelamento, perfuração, operações de fornalha, moagem, operações de equipamentos pesados, usinagem, despejamento/fundição, fixação de energia, rebites, lixamento, serragem e soldagem. Estes tampões de ouvido são comumente usados nas seguintes indústrias: agricultura, automotivo, produtos químicos, construção, fabricação geral, saúde, óleo e gás e produtos farmacêuticos. Estes tampões de ouvido têm uma Classificação de Redução de Ruído (NRR) de 29 dB, Classe AL. * Pode ser testado com o sistema de validação E-A-Rfit da 3M. A resistência à umidade ajuda a manter um ajuste consistente, mesmo quando há umidade. As estimativas dos Institutos Nacionais de Saúde sugerem que aproximadamente 15% dos americanos (26 milhões de pessoas) entre 20 e 69 anos tenham perda de audição de alta frequência devido à exposição ao ruído no trabalho ou durante atividades de lazer. bullet_point: [Prevents Surfer's Ear, Safe & easy equization for divers, Blocks dangerous high frequencies, Helps prevent ear infection, Preserves earwax to prevent Swimmer's Ear]
description:
Doc's ProPlugs can prevent swimmers ear, and ear pain by blocking water from entering the ears, keeping ears warm and preventing the flushing of water in and out of the ear. Ear pain and infection are caused by cold exposure and erosion of delicate skin and wax in the ear canal. Upon descent, ProPlugs prevent water from entering the ear down to 20 feet in depth. Once the diver enters greater depths, water will be allowed into the ear for equalization. Unlike other earplugs, ours includes a Scotts valve which allows ears to equalize easily and let sound in. Our ProPlugs have been used by hundreds of divers for over thirty years who testify that ProPlugs are the earplugs for divers. Equalization with Doc's ProPlugs: Doc's ProPlugs have also been used by divers who have trouble equalizing. Unlike other earplugs which are solid and would not be recommended for diving, ProPlugs are vented to allow equalization. While the small vent allows equalization to occur it does not allow debris to enter and it prevents earwax from washing out which exposes delicate ear tissue. The ProPlugs keep ears warm by storing the head's conductive heat; the warmth provided by the plugs drastically reduces the risk of thermal shock. Due to surface tension the vented plug also reduces abrupt pressure changes from reaching the sensitive eardrum which contributes to easier equalization. Clear ears often to allow air to escape through the ProPlugs vent and allow for better equalization. ProPlug wearers who have trouble clearing their ears should check to make sure a lump of ear wax is not blocking the canal or butting up against the vent. If the vent is fouled by debris while descending it is best to remove the ProPlug. If fouled while ascending, there is no problem because the air and water under pressure can escape around the ProPlug.Hundreds of divers have attested to the benefits of ProPlugs for relieving pressure in their ear during descent.

Doc's ProPlugs puede prevenir el dolor de oído y oído de los nadadores bloqueando el agua entre en los oídos, manteniendo las orejas calientes y evitando el lavado de agua dentro y fuera de la oreja. El dolor de oído y la infección son causados por la exposición al frío y la erosión de la piel delicada y la cera en el canal auditivo. Al descender, ProPlugs evita que el agua entre en la oreja hasta 20 pies de profundidad. Una vez que el buzo entre más profundidades, el agua se permitirá en el oído para la ecualización. A diferencia de otros tapones para los oídos, la nuestra incluye una válvula Scotts que permite que las orejas se igualen fácilmente y dejen entrar el sonido. Nuestros ProPlugs han sido utilizados por cientos de buceadores durante más de treinta años que testifican que ProPlugs son los tapones para los oídos para buceadores. Ecualización con ProPlugs: Doc's ProPlugs también han sido utilizados por buzos que tienen problemas para igualar. A diferencia de otros tapones para los oídos que son sólidos y no se recomiendan para bucear, ProPlugs están ventilados para permitir la ecualización. Mientras que el pequeño respiradero permite que ocurra la ecualización, no permite la entrada de desechos y evita que la cera de los oídos se lave, lo que expone el tejido delicado del oído. Los ProPlugs mantienen las orejas calientes al almacenar el calor conductor de la cabeza; el calor proporcionado por los tapones reduce drásticamente el riesgo de choque térmico. Debido a la tensión superficial, el tapón ventilado también reduce los cambios bruscos de presión al llegar al tímpano sensible, lo que contribuye a una ecualización más fácil. Orejas claras a menudo para permitir que el aire escape a través de la ventilación ProPlugs y permitir una mejor ecualización. Los usuarios de ProPlug que tienen problemas para limpiar sus oídos deben verificar para asegurarse de que un bulto de cera de oído no está bloqueando el canal o golpeando contra la ventilación. Si la rejilla de ventilación es ensuciada por escombros mientras desciende lo mejor es quitar el ProPlug. Si falta mientras ascende, no hay problema porque el aire y el agua bajo presión pueden escapar alrededor del ProPlug.Cientos de buceadores han atestiguado los beneficios de ProPlugs para aliviar la presión en el oído durante el descenso.

Doc's ProPlugs können Ohren- und Ohrenschmerzen durch das Eindringen von Wasser in die Ohren verhindern, die Ohren warm halten und das Eindringen von Wasser in und aus dem Ohr verhindern. Ohrenschmerzen und Infektionen werden durch Kälte und Erosion von empfindlicher Haut und Wachs im Gehörgang verursacht. Beim Abstieg verhindern ProPlugs das Eindringen von Wasser in das Ohr bis zu 6 m Tiefe. Sobald der Taucher in größere Tiefen eintritt, wird Wasser zum Ausgleich ins Ohr gelassen. Im Gegensatz zu anderen Ohrstöpseln verfügt unsere über ein Scotts Ventil, mit dem die Ohren leicht ausgeglichen werden können und Geräusche hereinlassen können. Unsere ProPlugs werden seit über dreißig Jahren von Hunderten von Tauchern verwendet, die beweisen, dass ProPlugs die Ohrstöpsel für Taucher sind. Ausgleich mit Doc's ProPlugs: Doc's ProPlugs wurden auch von Tauchern verwendet, die Schwierigkeiten beim Ausgleichen haben. Im Gegensatz zu anderen Ohrstöpseln, die solide sind und nicht zum Tauchen empfohlen werden, sind ProPlugs belüftet, um einen Ausgleich zu ermöglichen. Während die kleine Entlüftung einen Ausgleich ermöglicht, lässt es keinen Schmutz eindringen und es verhindert, dass Ohrenschmalz ausgewaschen wird, wodurch empfindliches Ohrgewebe freigelegt wird. Die ProPlugs halten die Ohren warm, indem sie die leitfähige Wärme des Kopfes speichern; die Wärme der Stecker reduziert das Risiko eines thermischen Schocks drastisch. Durch die Oberflächenspannung reduziert der belüftete Stecker auch abrupte Druckveränderungen beim Erreichen des empfindlichen Trommelfells, was zu einem leichteren Ausgleich beiträgt. Klare Ohren oft, damit Luft durch den ProPlugs entweichen kann und einen besseren Ausgleich ermöglichen. ProPlug-Träger, die Schwierigkeiten haben, ihre Ohren zu reinigen, sollten überprüfen, ob ein Klumpen Ohrenschmalz den Kanal nicht blockiert oder gegen die Lüftung stößt. Wenn die Lüftung beim Abstieg durch Schmutz verschmutzt ist, ist es am besten, den ProPlug zu entfernen. Wenn sie beim Aufstieg verschmutzt sind, gibt es kein Problem, da Luft und Wasser unter Druck um den ProPlug entweichen können. Hunderte von Tauchern haben die Vorteile von ProPlugs zur Druckentlastung im Ohr während des Abfahrts bestätigt.

WHAT IS NOISE REDUCTION RATING (NRR)?
A noise reduction rating indicates the level of sound that earplugs block out when used without simultaneous noise-blocking objects. This rating applies only to earplugs and earmuffs and provides users of these devices an important analytical tool when comparison shopping.
NRR Ratings
The highest NRR rating for earplugs is 33dB, and the highest available NRR rating for earmuffs is 31dB. These values reflect the level of noise protection available for each device when worn alone. Combining earplugs with earmuffs can offer a NRR protection level of 36dB. Manufacturers produce different types of earplugs and earmuffs to reach these ratings. Generally, higher-quality devices that cost more receive a higher NRR rating.
